nom: Peter Thomas Roth Potent-C Vitamin C Power Serum

segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several managing eczema or perioral dermatitis, report no irritation despite past reactions to other vitamin C products, sometimes after a short adjustment period of mild dryness or tingling; two reviewers not normally prone to reactions instead report a severe rash, burning, or bad breakouts, and one warns sensitive-skin users away from the product altogether.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose skin turned dry and aged-looking over a cold winter, report it restores moisture and a smoother, younger-looking appearance; one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin instead broke out badly on her cheeks.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s who describe their skin as mature or aging report firmer, brighter, more youthful-looking skin with visibly reduced fine lines within one to several weeks; one reviewer notes she is significantly younger than the product's target demographic and has not seen the dramatic results pictured on the box.

concerns.aging: A large number of reviewers, especially those in their 40s to 70s, report visibly smoother fine lines, firmer skin, and improved elasticity within a few weeks of consistent use; several others report no noticeable change in lines or firmness even after three or more weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who comment on hydration say the serum leaves skin noticeably hydrated, smooth, and glowing, sometimes taking up to fifteen minutes to fully absorb; no reviewer in this set reports it leaving skin drier.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with typically reactive skin that turns red from almost everything says this serum caused no redness at all; another reviewer, who does not normally have sensitive skin, reports her face and neck turned bright red and felt like it was burning.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visibly lighter dark spots, sun spots, melasma, or acne scars within weeks of regular use; a few report no change to their discoloration, including one whose single age spot did not fade even as the rest of her skin improved.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some with a history of cystic acne, report fewer breakouts or lesions with regular use; two reviewers instead describe new breakouts, one badly on her cheeks and another with small acne bumps during the first week that resolved after continued use.

aspects.libelle: Pump can break or stop dispensing
Bottle often underfilled for the price
Feels greasy or heavy on skin
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I do not normally have sensitive skin. This product caused my face to blister with a rash. My entire face and neck turned bright red and felt like it was burning. I returned it immediately. Hopefully my skin clears up soon.

I have normal to dry sensitive skin. This is an absolute no for me. The smell is so strong of orange peel and cinnamon(?) it should have been an indicator that this was not going to work for me. The consistency is nice when it comes out combined but it has separation issues. Very hydrating feeling but it broke me out horribly on my cheeks. This might be a product for more mature skin as I'm only 28 and this is very heavy. Thank goodness it was just a sample size but I'm going to stick with caudalie's vitamin c alternative.
This is one of the more expensive products I find myself repurchasing! I have very sensitive/eczema prone skin and this does not irritate it at all. All you need is one pump!

Let's see I have been using this product for about 6 months now and I love it. I'm Hispanic and in my younger years, I would have said I had oily skin. I live in N.VA and noticed this last winter my skin was dry and old looking. I was pregnant and on the cusp of 40 years old. My skin was in absolute shambles. I wanted a autumn but a lotion type that would provide some moisture as well. I finally broke down and bought this one. First time I used it the smell caught me off guard. For a lot of people it might smell not so great but I love the smell of cloves and that is what it smells like to me. It also made my face tingle the first few weeks but I got used to that and enjoy the feeling now. I have somewhat sensitive skin and turn red from almost everything, not this. No negative reaction from it at all. My skin is smooth and youthful looking again. Love this product and will continue buying it.

I am lost on all these smelly issues. I am blind and have hypersensitive sense of smell. I've read the smells of hot dog water to Tar and plastic, which all smell significantly different. Which is it? I smell vitamin C; a very mild orange very lite fragrance. Definitely not a deal breaker. When my very flaky, dry, sensitive, mature skin with lesions from cystic acne is now more balanced than it's ever been and I'm 51 years old. It is a little on the greasy side temporarily which is why I use it only at night about 30 min before bedtime. I use water drench for daytime. If you have time on you're hands with patience you can use it during the day. You'd need to apply about an hour before makeup to fully absorb. It was the only product that allowed me to exit my home with less breakouts. The breakouts turned to lesions that freaked people out. This product gave me a ticket out of hiding and I'm thankful.

extraits.titre: Most amazing skin care product ever!
extraits.texte: I cannot rave about this product enough. I have struggled with acne, sensitive skin, redness, texture from picking acne as a teen, etc. This is the first product ever that has helped with everything "wrong" with my skin. I have been using it consistently for about a month & my skin looks SO much better. I finally feel okay going outside my home without a drop of makeup on. Each week it just gets better & better. I will warn you that you'll want to start with using this just once a day. It did give me some dryness & peeling the first week of use & some small acne bumps. After that first week though I had no further issues & I increased to using twice a day after two weeks. I have no idea why there are so many complaints about the smell. I think it smells like you'd expect a vitamin c product to smell, it isn't bad nor very strong to me. This stuff seriously works, you won't regret using it. Just remember to give it a chance to work, you can't quit after just 3 days & expect the amazing results.

I saw an improvement in the first week. I'm 74 years old and a sun lover....my skin is brighter...the 1 age spot has not disappeared (I was hoping that it would). But my skin is firmer and the fine lines are appreciably reduced. I am absolutely amazed!
